summary.zh: 桌面版下载全面直达：README 与用户手册提供固定直链，点击即下载对应芯片的安装包，不再跳转页面。
summary.en: Desktop downloads go direct: the README and user manual now link straight to the right dmg for your chip — one click, no page hops.

highlights.zh: README 新增桌面版下载入口：Apple 芯片 / Intel 芯片直链，点击直接下载对应 dmg。
highlights.en: The READMEs gain a desktop download entry with direct links for Apple silicon and Intel Macs — clicking downloads the right dmg immediately.

highlights.zh: 用户手册安装章节提供全部直接下载地址（含校验文件），并说明两种芯片的区别。
highlights.en: The user manual's install chapter lists every direct download URL (checksums included) and explains the chip difference.

highlights.zh: 发布流程新增固定名安装包别名（ModelSwap-arm64.dmg / ModelSwap-x64.dmg），下载地址从此永不随版本变化。
highlights.en: The release pipeline now uploads fixed-name aliases (ModelSwap-arm64.dmg / ModelSwap-x64.dmg), so download URLs never change with versions.
